label: June 2026 primary financing and company statistics
type: Primary company release hosted by participating investor
note: Announces a $750m primary financing at $44bn. June 1 company statistics: over $1bn annualized revenue, positive free cash flow and over 70,000 customers. Annualized revenue is not subscription ARR; audited statements and security terms are not supplied.

label: Contribution-profit terminology in November company post
note: The post identifies underlying profitability as contribution profit. It gives no complete line-by-line reconciliation. Modeled account contributions are separate from the company measure.

label: Current free/Plus/Enterprise pricing
note: Plus is $15 per user per month plus a platform fee based on team size, with a 20% annual-billing discount advertised. The buyer model uses monthly list pricing; its platform fee is assumed, and the discount and payment-method fees are excluded.

label: Rewards Terms
note: Qualified purchases, Ramp-set rates, eligibility and redemption conditions. These terms establish no universal cashback rate. The modeled 1.2% reward expense is hypothetical.

label: AI token-spend management strategy
note: Describes tools to view AI usage and cost, assign it to teams or use cases, and control spending. Promotional economic or model-quality claims are not treated as independent causal evidence.
